criteria.1.1: WHEN an operator registers a Discount_Code with a valid Code_String, Discount_Kind, value, Minimum_Subtotal, and Expiry_Date, THE Code_Registry SHALL store it and return it on lookup by that Code_String.
criteria.1.2: IF a percent value is outside the integer range 1–90, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.1.3: IF a fixed value is not an integer ≥1 cent, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.1.4: IF the Code_String is empty, longer than 20 characters, or holds a character outside `A–Z`, `0–9`, `-`, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.1.5: IF a Code_String is already registered, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the second registration with a duplicate error.
criteria.1.6: IF the Minimum_Subtotal is not an integer ≥0, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.1.7: IF the Expiry_Date is not a real calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.1.8: IF the Discount_Kind is not `percent` or `fixed`, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the registration with a validation error.
criteria.2.1: WHEN a shopper sends `POST /carts/<id>/discount` with a registered, unexpired Code_String and the Subtotal is at least the Minimum_Subtotal, THE Cart_API SHALL attach the code to the Cart and return status 200 with `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.2.2: IF the Code_String is not registered, THEN THE Cart_API SHALL return status 404 with error `unknown code`.
criteria.2.3: IF the Clock date is after the Expiry_Date, THEN THE Cart_API SHALL return status 410 with error `code expired`.
criteria.2.4: IF the Subtotal is below the Minimum_Subtotal, THEN THE Cart_API SHALL return status 422 with error `minimum not met`.
criteria.2.5: IF the request body has no `code` field or the field is not a string, THEN THE Cart_API SHALL return status 400 with error `bad code`.
criteria.2.6: IF the `code` field is a string that is not a valid Code_String, THEN THE Cart_API SHALL return status 400 with error `bad code`.
criteria.2.7: WHEN more than one error condition holds for `POST /carts/<id>/discount`, THE Cart_API SHALL return the error of the first failing check in this order: 400, 404, 410, 422, 409.
criteria.2.8: WHEN a shopper sends `POST` or `DELETE /carts/<id>/discount` for a cart id that does not exist, THE Cart_API SHALL return status 404 with error `no cart` before it runs any other check.
criteria.3.1: WHILE a Cart has an Applied_Code, WHEN a shopper applies a different valid, registered, unexpired Code_String whose Minimum_Subtotal the Subtotal meets, THE Cart_API SHALL return status 409 with error `code already applied`.
criteria.3.2: WHILE a Cart has an Applied_Code, WHEN a shopper applies the same Code_String again and the code is unexpired and the Subtotal is at least the Minimum_Subtotal, THE Cart_API SHALL return status 200 with the current totals.
criteria.3.3: WHEN a shopper sends `DELETE /carts/<id>/discount`, THE Cart_API SHALL remove the Applied_Code and return status 200 with `discount_cents` equal to 0.
criteria.3.4: WHEN the Cart_API returns status 409 with error `code already applied`, THE Cart SHALL keep its Applied_Code unchanged.
criteria.4.1: WHERE the Applied_Code has Discount_Kind `percent`, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to floor(Subtotal × value ÷ 100) cents.
criteria.4.2: WHERE the Applied_Code has Discount_Kind `fixed`, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to the smaller of the value and the Subtotal.
criteria.4.3: THE Cart SHALL keep the Total in the range 0 to Subtotal cents.
criteria.4.4: WHEN a shopper sends `GET /carts/<id>`, THE Cart_API SHALL return `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, `total_cents`, and the Applied_Code's Code_String or null.
criteria.4.5: WHILE a Cart has no Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0.
criteria.4.6: WHILE the Subtotal of a Cart is below the Minimum_Subtotal of its Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0.
criteria.4.7: WHILE the Clock date is after the Expiry_Date of the Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0.
criteria.4.8: WHILE the Clock date is after the Expiry_Date of the Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL keep the Applied_Code attached.
